question: Should OpenClaw add a plugin-visible skill install/update completion observer now, and what redacted payload plus observer-failure semantics should it expose?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing observer, but choosing what install metadata plugins may receive and whether observer failures affect an already-written install is a product and security boundary decision.

options.title: Add Minimal Observer
options.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, outcome, and timing metadata plus documented fail-open logging semantics.

options.title: Keep Pre-Install Only
options.body: Declare `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` sufficient for install security and close or narrow the audit-observer request separately.

options.title: Defer To ClawHub Trust Design
options.body: Hold the observer until maintainers define a broader ClawHub trust and provenance API that can supply audit events.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Observer
recommendation.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, outcome, and timing metadata plus documented fail-open logging semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans ClawHub skill install behavior and install security policy, and prior issue discussion already routes this lifecycle decision through that area.
